page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Page number 245 at the head. Catchword "uis" at the lower right and signature "Q 3" at the lower left below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: filius arbitrium, & sententiam definiri conten-deret, & scripsit librum contra Nicolaum Pon-tificem, quem a pluribus Episcopis subscribi curauerat, vt patet ex libro Pontificali in vita Adriani II. Tertio cum Basilio Imperatore par-ricida, qui eum ab officio remouit, dissimulans causam veram, & prætendens aliam, quod alie-nam sedem nimirum Ignatij iniuste obtineret: & iussit eum Romæ coram Adriano II. litigare. Misit etiam librum illius contra Nicolaum, scriptum ad Adrianum, qui isthic in Synodo damnatus, & exutus est, ac missi Legati Constantinopoli in Synodo Photium declararunt depositum, & excommunicatum, vt patet ex Actis eius Synodi. Postea tamen cum Basilius fraudes Romanas agnouisset, & Ignatius e vinculis sublatus esset, Photium restituit in pristi-nam sedem, unde iterum expulit Leo Philosophus Imperator, ac in Armeniorum Monasterium relegauit, vbi videtur esse mortuus.

Et hic nugipolyloquides, licet aphoristice scribat, vel legisse historias, vel lectas non intellexisse, velrerum momenta nullo pacto examinasse dicetur. Credant scioli, credant festiui Saperdæ. page.notes: The first line of the text begins mid-sentence and is a continuation from the previous page. The word "filius" is set with a long s and may read as "silius" [?]. The first occurrence of "impostEnsuras" in the line "impostEnsuras de rebus" is a misreading on my part; the printed word is "impostu-ras" and the line should read "impofturas de rebus". Inky dots in the right margin are ink specks, not notes. Lower margin: "uis" is the catchword and "Q 3" the signature.
